unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U26: Apply exemption,public-interest and third-party consultation distinctions

payload.title: Consultation is neither automatic disclosure nor a veto
payload.core_explanation_md:
The statutory exemptions cover different protected interests, including the described security, commercial, fiduciary, investigation and personal-information categories. Identify the actual harm/test and the applicable dated provision. Section8(2) preserves its separate public-interest weighing, and the twenty-year rule has stated exceptions; age alone is not a universal release rule.

Where the qualifying confidential third-party process applies, the source describes notice within five days and an opportunity for representation within ten days. The representation is considered by the decision-maker; the third party objection is not automatically a conclusive veto. Equally, consultation is not permission to disclose without exemption analysis. Preserve the notice, representation, reasons and appeal information.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a third party objection automatically decide the request?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The authority must make the applicable reasoned statutory decision.

payload.stem_md: A third party objects to release of its confidential material, and the PIO treats the objection as a final legal veto without analysis. What is missing?

options.text_md: A rule that consultation can never occur
The PIO reasoned exemption/public-interest decision after considering the representation
options.explanation_md: Consultation does not transfer the decision entirely to the third party.

options.text_md: Automatic release because any objection is irrelevant

payload.correct_explanation_md: Consultation does not transfer the decision entirely to the third party.

payload.stem_md: An officer says every record older than twenty years must be released regardless of category. Which qualification matters?

options.text_md: The stated exceptions to the twenty-year rule

options.explanation_md: The described twenty-year access rule expressly preserves specified exemption categories.

options.text_md: Old records cease to be information
options.explanation_md: Age does not erase information status.

options.text_md: Only records written in ink count
options.explanation_md: Medium does not establish the exception.
